title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards — Held-Funds Cap for Registrants by Card Spend at Marlowe & Finch (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
**Cap rule.** On a refund of registry credit left undeducted on a Merchandise Purchases unit, a registrant whose Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to a Marlowe & Finch card in the twelve calendar months before the request date (purchases whose transaction date falls less than twelve whole months before it) reach the upper card-spend threshold of $3000.00 has the upper held-funds cap of $15.00; one whose such purchases reach the middle card-spend threshold of $1000.00 but not the upper has the middle held-funds cap of $8.00. A registrant whose such purchases total less than $1000.00 is outside this rule.

The purchases are read from the card transactions of the registrant's Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts: purchase transactions at Marlowe & Finch.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical totals)

| Card purchases at Marlowe & Finch, past twelve months | Held-funds cap |
|---|---|
| $3000.00 | $15.00 |
| $2999.99 | $8.00 |
| $1000.00 | $8.00 |
| $999.99 | outside this rule |

A held-funds credit of $10.50 before the cap (hypothetical) stays $10.50 under the upper cap and becomes $8.00 under the middle cap.
